LanguageData.USAC_Gun_AssaultRifle.label: advanced auto rifle
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_AssaultRifle.description: An advanced precision rifle that strikes a fine balance between accuracy, power and weight. Its full-power ammunition punches through conventional ballistic plate, though it fires more slowly than a standard assault rifle.
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_AssaultRifle.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_AssaultRifle.tools.barrel.label: barrel
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_LightMachinegun.label: advanced LMG
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_LightMachinegun.description: A precision rifle rebuilt for sustained fire, with an air-cooled barrel and belt feed. Its full-power rounds punch through conventional ballistic protection, but the weapon is bulky enough that its user needs the rest of the squad covering them.
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_MarksmanRifle.label: advanced marksman rifle
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_MarksmanRifle.description: A precision rifle modified for rapid follow-up shots at long range. Its full-power ammunition still defeats conventional ballistic protection at distance, which makes it an ideal marksman's weapon.
LanguageData.USAC_Gun_MarksmanRifle.tools.stock.label: stock
